checks.name: JavaScript parses and initializes without host controls
Two named alternatives retain separate product containers
No network API or operational endpoint in prototype
Overview distinguishes stale and incomplete data
Widget expansion and stale state have explicit semantics
Each period has one selected control and stale CPU is labeled historical
Charts recompute geometry at narrow and large container widths
Embedded identity, container resizing and reduced-motion rules exist
Appearance values are validated and four palettes have explicit selection
One appearance update synchronizes both controllers and preserves local state
